sources.title: Iran Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Islamic Republic of Iran
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry eVisa endpoint currently self-redirects in normal replay, preventing recovery of a current nationality selector, passport-type result or issuance route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: HTTP 307 redirects this URL to itself during review.

sources.title: Spain Ministry of Foreign Affairs: Iran travel recommendations
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation, Spain
sources.officialityEvidence: Spain’s Tehran Embassy guidance is the competent current passport-government source; its 13 April 2026 rule is retained only as a contradiction because direct replay is access-restricted.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Irán dejó de expedir visados en frontera (visa on arrival) desde el inicio de la pandemia.

sources.title: Interests Section of the Islamic Republic of Iran: How to Apply for a Visa to Iran
sources.publisher: Interests Section of the Islamic Republic of Iran, Embassy of Pakistan, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Interests Section’s revised October 2025 instructions describe electronic issuance only for applicants residing in the United States or Canada, not a passport-wide route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The visa will only be issued electronically, and a copy will be sent to the email address provided.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live visa-on-arrival nationality dataset
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry front end calls this no-cache endpoint. Fresh retrieval returned exactly 53 marked arrival records, all canonical and none residual.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live tourist nationality-eligibility endpoint
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The live front end posts RSA-encrypted tourist visaTypeId and nationality OCR-code requests here. Fresh base checks for all 136 residuals returned each electronic and arrival flag false.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Applicant is not eligible for applying e-visa.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: tourist eligibility category configuration
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, State of Kuwait
sources.officialityEvidence: The live first-party bundle maps category three to a valid US, UK or Schengen tourist-visa holder, a third-country-document condition rather than passport-nationality entitlement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: US, UK, or Schengen valid tourist visa holder

sources.title: Tourist Visit Visa
sources.publisher: Kuwait Government Online / Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Ministry service describes a separate sponsor and hotel workflow, not an unconditional passport-nationality result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A copy of the sponsor’s Civil ID.

sources.title: GEN 1.3 — Entry, Transit and Departure of Passengers and Crew
sources.publisher: Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Syrian eAIP is published by GACA under ICAO Annex 15; live GEN 1.3 is effective 27 March 2026 and sets a default rule without a nationality annex.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry visa obtained in advance from a Syrian diplomatic mission, unless exempt.

sources.title: Foreign Ministry: no changes to procedures for arrivals to Syria
sources.publisher: Syrian Arab News Agency / Ministry of Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The official state news agency reports the Foreign Ministry’s 29 April 2026 confirmation that Decision 128 remains in force, but does not publish its nationality annex or ordinary-passport schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: لا توجد أي تغييرات على الإجراءات المعتمدة لدخول الوافدين إلى سوريا.
